x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: CLI tool for the Browserbase SDK.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key. Falls back to configured environment variables, dotnet user-secrets, and the optional credential file.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Override the API base URL.

options.name: --json
options.description: Render structured responses as raw JSON instead of human-readable text. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write response content to this file path instead of stdout.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Write one file per returned item when the response contains multiple resources.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Inspect and manage API credentials used by the generated CLI.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Store an API key in dotnet user-secrets.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the authentication source order the CLI will use.

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear the API key stored in dotnet user-secrets.

options.name: --project-id
options.description: The Project ID. Can be found in [Settings](https://www.browserbase.com/settings). Optional - if not provided, the project will be inferred from the API key.

options.name: --input
options.description: Load request JSON from a file path, '-' for stdin, or an inline JSON object/array string.

options.name: --request-json
options.description: Request body as JSON.

options.name: --request-file
options.description: Path to a JSON request file, or '-' for stdin.

commands.name: downloads-delete
commands.description:
Delete a Download
Delete a download file from storage and mark as deleted.

commands.name: downloads-get
commands.description:
Get a Download
Get download metadata (Accept: application/json) or file content (Accept: application/octet-stream).

commands.name: downloads-list
commands.description:
List Downloads
List all downloads for a session with optional filtering and pagination.

options.name: --session-id
options.description: Filter downloads by session ID (required).

options.name: --filename
options.description: Filter by exact filename match.

options.name: --mime-type
options.description: Filter by MIME type.

options.name: --min-size
options.description: Minimum file size in bytes.

options.name: --max-size
options.description: Maximum file size in bytes.

options.name: --created-after
options.description: Filter downloads created on or after this timestamp.

options.name: --created-before
options.description: Filter downloads created on or before this timestamp.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of results to return.

options.name: --offset
options.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

commands.name: fetch-create
commands.description:
Fetch a Page
Fetch a page and return its content, headers, and metadata.

options.name: --allow-redirects
options.description: Whether to follow HTTP redirects Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --allow-insecure-ssl
options.description: Whether to bypass TLS certificate verification Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --proxies
options.description: Whether to enable proxy support for the request Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format for the response content. `raw` (default) returns the response body unchanged; `json` returns structured data (requires `schema`); `markdown` returns the page as markdown.

options.name: --schema
options.description: JSON Schema describing the desired structure of the response. Only used when `format` is `json`.
